goal: Implement micro-momentum and immediate volume surge gatekeeper with candidate cascading in Auto Trader BETA to eliminate buying dormant coins

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderRunnerConfig { assignedCapital: number; requireMicroMomentum?: boolean; minVolumeSurgeRatio?: number; maxDistanceToLocalHighPct?: number; microKlineInterval?: string; }

execution_steps: Write comprehensive unit test suite in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_micro_momentum.test.js covering volume surge ratio checks, proximity to 15m high, and candidate cascading
Run node --test to verify red phase
Implement evaluateMicroMomentum and cascading candidate selection in frontend/src/lib/autoTraderRunner.ts
Run node --test to verify green phase
Run npm run build and npx oxlint
Update scripts/run_live_paper_test.js to display micro-momentum metrics in live logs
Run Live Paper Trading Session #4 with Binance Spot data keeping 15-min stagnation window to measure isolated impact
acceptance_criteria: evaluateMicroMomentum validates volume surge ratio >= minVolumeSurgeRatio (default 1.25) against 10-bar SMA
evaluateMicroMomentum verifies price proximity to 15-bar local high within maxDistanceToLocalHighPct (default 0.8%)
Candidate cascading tries candidate #2 or #3 if candidate #1 lacks immediate momentum, avoiding dead money
If no candidate has micro-momentum surge, NO_TRADE is issued with reason LACKS_IMMEDIATE_IMPULSE
maxStagnationSeconds is maintained at 900s (15m) for this stage
All unit tests pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: Zero private Binance API or real money endpoints are used
Live Paper Trading Session #4 demonstrates entry into an actively surging coin

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- frontend/src/lib/autoTraderRunner.ts scripts/run_live_paper_test.js; rm -f frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_micro_momentum.test.js contracts/TSK-AUTOTRADER-007.contract.json
